# Kaydo

> Kaydo is a private, end-to-end-encrypted sanctuary for your family's memories.
> No ads, no AI training, no data selling — just your stories, photos, letters,
> recipes and scrapbooks, preserved for the people you love.

Each family gets its own space at `your-name.kaydo.app`. Everything is encrypted,
you own and can export all of your data at any time, and the app is open source.

## Core pages

- [Home / overview](https://kaydo.app/): What Kaydo is and how to claim your family name.
- [Log in](https://kaydo.app/login): Sign in to an existing family space.
- [Sign up](https://kaydo.app/signup): Create a new family space.

## Features

- [Moments & Memories](https://kaydo.app/#features): Privately share photos, videos and voice memos with your family.
- [The Vault](https://kaydo.app/#features): Securely store high-fidelity originals of your most precious files.
- [The Letters](https://kaydo.app/#features): Write messages to be delivered to loved ones in the future.
- [Recipe Tree](https://kaydo.app/#features): Preserve and evolve family recipes across generations.
- [Digital Scrapbook](https://kaydo.app/#features): Turn memories into handcrafted, drag-and-drop pages.
- [Data Export](https://kaydo.app/#features): Own and export all of your data whenever you want.

## Privacy & security

- [Privacy commitments](https://kaydo.app/#privacy): No ads, no AI training, no data selling.
- [Security](https://kaydo.app/#security): End-to-end encryption and verified-members-only access.
